title: Houston Sword Sports

services.name: Fencing
services.desc: Give a kid a stick and they’ll start swordfighting. Fencing is a safe, exciting and fun sport and is a great option for PE units, field day or field trip activities, and especially after-school classes. Fencing challenges the body and mind by developing balance, agility, focus, decision making, and spatial reasoning. Studies show martial arts like fencing develop self-discipline, impulse control, and mental manipulation, giving kids the tools to succeed in school. Fencing is equally suited to girls and boys. It also is a popular sport for students with physical disabilities. We can even give wheelchair fencing
